title: Moving a job to the next slot or day (move-over)
keywords: move over next day movable non-movable reschedule moveover file buyer
body: Only movable jobs may be moved. Never move: medical/telemedical, SGH (without Hamyzan), TikTok, bakes/cakes/cooked food, or other non-movables.
Shopee/Lazada AM: at 11.45am move movable AM jobs to PM — call buyers, update sellers, check PUIP. No jobs may expire after 12pm.
Shopee/Lazada PM: 4.30–5pm move movable Pending Acceptance jobs to the next day and log them in the Move-over file. Zero Pending Acceptance by 5pm.
Shopee may roll up to 5% of jobs (movables only). Lazada must hit 100%.
Update the Move-over file at end of day.
